notes.title: Quicktravel & Blueprints
notes.notes: [p]There are some new features, and I am constantly surprised by how many topics I am currently able to include in these updates. Due to the procedurally generated map, it is often not possible to integrate new objects into existing game saves. However, I always try to make it as backward compatible as possible with your game saves.[/p][p][/p][h3]Quicktravel[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40004523/e0135f5489733a32fd1a673d4dd83d957c2d95f6.png"][/img][/p][p]The Danu statues around the world are now finally available as fast travel points. However, to activate them, you must offer them a Danu sphere. In your existing saves, you can craft these directly, but in newer saves, you must first obtain a crafting recipe or find another way to obtain Danu spheres.[/p][p]Danu statues spawn in special places up to a distance of 1 km from the portal ruins. They can also spawn on existing maps, but only in areas you have not yet visited. [/p][p][/p][h3]Blueprints[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40004523/b60128394af4228aae3d21c61ed3bdd65fe01bf9.png"][/img][/p][p]When you start a new game, many recipes are no longer directly in your recipe book. This makes it easier to find your way around at the beginning of the game and find the right recipes to progress. Jackie, Jack's sister, sells blueprints for wood recipes. More blueprints will be added to the game in the future through other merchants and quests.[/p][p]You need a Tinker's Table to view and research blueprints. To unlock a recipe in a blueprint, you need the raw materials displayed.[/p][p][/p][h3]Main-Quest[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40004523/923bfcada8ae2cc050495a7b70d9503f1de8979b.png"][/img][/p][p]Jolana Romba's tent can also be found on new maps. Whenever you get stuck, she can give you a hint. Jolana reads the threads of fate and guides you through the main story in a role-playing fashion, without quest logs pulling you out of your immersion.[/p][p]Her name and headband hint at a little Easter egg – can you spot it?[/p][p][/p][p][b]Graphics[/b][/p][list][*][p]The light cone of light sources has been visually improved.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Adjustments[/b][/p][list][*][p]Bookshelves and cupboards are now located under the Base Building category.[/p][/*][*][p]Many players missed the book at merchants or furnaces, so it now flashes until it is opened for the first time.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Technology[/b][/p][list][*][p]Some internal data and configuration migrations.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Performance[/b][/p][list][*][p]The number of preload objects has been reduced to reduce micro-lag caused by a Unity bug.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Bug fixes[/b][/p][list][*][p]After a config migration, the Leather Jerkin, Moss Vest, and Tunic could no longer be equipped.[/p][/*][*][p]When using a controller, the interaction target was sometimes incorrect.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Known bugs[/b][/p][list][*][p]On maps prior to this version, the entrance to Theater Square can be destroyed.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Coming soon[/b][/p][list][*][p]The first dungeon - The Abandoned Mines.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Fun with bombs!
notes.notes:
Fun with bombs! You'll have to collect a few different items, but then nothing stands in the way of bombing fun! :>

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40004523/fdafe018802af957fe3c153651518c13ea48d615.gif[/img]


[b]New objects[/b]
[list]
[*] You can now craft "Kindlegrit" in the Cauldron.
[*] You can now use kindlegrit to make bombs at the stone anvil. Pick up bombs with the interact button and throw them with the attack button.
[*] You can now craft repair kits.
[*] You can now repair non-magically repairable items at the repair table.
[*] You can now make threads at the tailor's table. These will replace ropes for many recipes.
[*] "Rift Spire" mushrooms now grow in the portal ruins.
[/list]

[b]New features[/b]
[list]
[*] Spears now have a stab animation with increased range.
[/list]

[b]Graphics[/b]
[list]
[*] The smoke images have been slightly improved.
[*] Many light sources now glow.
[/list]

[b]Gameplay[/b]
[list]
[*] Improved detection of which actor was clicked.
[*] The interaction marker on the ground is now only displayed for placeable objects.
[*] The marker for Tari now blinks so you don't miss quest events so easily.
[*] Boss loot boxes now also have a blinking marker, as they sometimes appear behind trees or other objects.
[*] At the beginning of the game, Tari explains that the player can unlock more recipes by crafting items.
[/list]

[b]Adjustments[/b]
[list]
[*] The range of swords has been slightly increased, but the width of the attack has been slightly reduced.
[*] Rails are now more vulnerable to explosions.
[*] Explosions ignore the short-term hit protection after a hit.
[*] Only one material is now used for repairs, regardless of how many repair sets are required for the repair.
[*] Farmland now dries out more slowly so that farms can also be watered by Darti.
[*] Explosions no longer remove water.
[*] Some dialogs have been reworked.
[/list]

[b]Technology[/b]
[list]
[*] Some internal technical adjustments and migrations.
[/list]

[b]Bugfixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Opening the game menu while attacking released the controls again.
[*] When using seats quickly, the character started to "fly".
[*] Objects could be retrieved from the trash can.
[*] Seats could be exited into house walls.
[*] Spewdew could block loading when exiting houses.
[/list]

[b]Known bugs[/b]
[list]
[*] Sometimes cliffs are not displayed correctly.
[/list]

[b]Coming soon[/b]
[list]
[*] Blueprint recipes!
[/list]

notes.title: Minecarts!
notes.notes:
It's time to swing the pickaxe and collect iron, because minecarts are on the loose! This is one of several preparation updates for the first dungeon, so full speed ahead and don't get derailed!


[b]New objects[/b]
[list]
[*] You can now craft wooden and iron minecarts, each with different speeds.
[/list]

[b]New features[/b]
[list]
[*] Tools now have freeze frames when used.
[*] The sword animation now has 3 hit-stop frames when hitting "soft targets".
[*] Your character now "shakes" when you hit a "hard target".
[/list]

[b]Graphics[/b]
[list]
[*] A new water shader is now active for all game characters.
[*] The desert sand tileset has been improved and now uses alternating outline tiles.
[*] A respawn animation has been added.
[*] The magic dust image has been improved.
[*] Shadows of objects have been improved, making them appear less gray.
[*] The shadow calculation of the different hairstyles on the character has been improved.
[*] The shovel animations have been reworked.
[*] When hitting water with a tool, water splashes appear.
[/list]

[b]Adjustments[/b]
[list]
[*] The "Quick Stack" button for chests has been changed to "Take All".
[*] The Cauldron is now crafted at the Anvil, like other metal recipes.
[*] You can now use birch wood to make sticks and wood rods.
[*] The stone fireplace can now be found under the “Crafting” category.
[*] The use of shears and buckets is now preferred over picking things up. For example, you no longer gather the grass when you want to shear your sheep.
[*] The activation frames for the hoe and shovel animations have been made more suitable for the animation.
[*] The hoe can now also destroy grass.
[*] Chicks move a bit faster now.
[/list]

[b]Technology[/b]
[list]
[*] The player character now runs on an improved state machine.
[*] Local audio sources now have a maximum range.
[/list]

[b]Performance[/b]
[list]
[*] Terrain tilesets are now built and processed in a more optimized way.
[/list]

[b]Bugfixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Mushrooms and tomatoes were ignored by the path finder.
[*] It was no longer possible to load savegames with a corrupted save file.
[*] If an item cannot be picked up, the input detection no longer triggers an alternative action.
[*] Dialogs can now only be started from a neutral character state.
[*] Lightnings have been spawned around the character when warping home during combat with Aztetor.
[*] Water pillars have been spawned around the character when warping home during the battle with Volgoda.
[*] Boss fight music did not always start correctly.
[*] Fixed an issue where gold coins would not animate correctly when selling items.
[*] The dust clouds while running often remained active.
[/list]

[b]Known bugs[/b]
[list]
[*] Sometimes cliffs are not displayed correctly.
[/list]

[b]Coming soon[/b]
[list]
[*] Bombs!
[/list]

notes.title: Bugfixes on Rails
notes.notes:
Big updates always bring some bugs with them. I therefore want to say thank you to everyone who helps me with testing and enables me to find even the most unlikely special cases! <3


[b]New Features[/b]
[list]
[*] You can now craft rails for a mine cart track. However, the mine cart is still under development and will come with the next bigger update.
[/list]

[b] Adjustments[/b]
[list]
[*] Tari now instantly moves from the spot if you don't want to warp back.
[*] Interaction with world objects is now prioritized over dialogs. The only exception is talking to NPCs on chairs or benches.
[/list]

[b]Bugfixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Due to a bug in the chunk limitation, animals were sometimes pushed out of their enclosures.
[*] An optimization of the actor movement lock during the loading of chunks caused Tari to partially stop moving.
[*] The day counter started with the wrong day and sometimes skipped a day.
[*] Body parts of Volgoda were saved separately and thus remained permanently in the map.
[*] When trying to put Darti in an enclosure, the game could crash because the mechanic selection could not select a suitable action.
[*] Darti's watering function could lead to internal errors, but these had no consequences.
[*] The new sleep events of the Darti were not de-registered, which led to a small memory leak.
[*] The Darti's new awareness module did not always correctly recognize when you moved away and approached them again. This caused the Darti to stop attacking even though you were close to it.
[*] Deleted game objects were sometimes not removed from the player's view detection, resulting in a small memory leak.
[*] Objects could be repaired by dropping them on the ground or placing them with a right-click.
[*] Pressing the sprint button while attacking or using a tool would put the character into a deadlock.
[*] The game loading screen crashed if there was no permission to read the save files.
[/list]

[b]Known Bugs[/b]
[list]
[*] Sometimes cliffs are not displayed correctly.
[/list]

[b]Coming soon[/b]
[list]
[*] A mine dungeon, bombs and a mine track.
[/list]

notes.title: Valentine's Days
notes.notes:
Happy Valentine's Day to all of you!
It's a bit close, but I managed to add a little Valentine's Day treat: Rain of Hearts!
In addition to this nice little gimmick, this update brings a bunch of significant performance improvements and two new enemies. The technology behind the enemies in particular will allow for more individual enemies and animals in future. Specific modules such as a sleep module or improved awareness of the environment for social aggro are just two of them.

Have fun and thank you for all the great support! <3


[b]New features[/b]
[list]
[*] In the days around Valentine's Day, hearts now mix in with the rain.
[*] At the new magic repair table, you can now use energy cores and materials to repair your items. But be careful, not every item is worth repairing!
[*]Your in-game days are now counted, displayed in the morning and shown on the loading screen.
[*] You can now get water slime and Darti hats from Dartis.
[/list]

[b]New enemies[/b]
[list]
[*] The Spewdew is an aggressive plant that spits acid at its victims to fertilize its surroundings! You can collect Spewseeds and plant Spewdew yourself. In the future, you will need Spewseeds to make bombs.
[*] The Darti is an axolotl-waterslime-cat. They react together when you attack one and spit water at you. If you lure Dartis onto your fields, they will water them.
[/list]

[b]Graphics[/b]
[list]
[*] Small dust clouds now appear during running.
[/list]

[b]Customizations[/b]
[list]
[*] Items are no longer destroyed when their durability drops to 0. You can repair your items and use them again.
[*] The materials required to craft tools, weapons and armor have been adjusted, since they are now repairable.
[*] Taria and the Månefury now have special “ticks” in their dialogs.
[*] Running is no longer possible in shallow water.
[/list]

[b]Technology[/b]
[list]
[*] Major performance improvement through a structural update in the map generator.
[*] Reduced micro-lags due to a performance improvement in the animation generator.
[*] The loading time when warping via Tari has been massively improved by chunk preloading.
[*] General performance improvement through faster chunk despawn.
[*] Reduction of micro-lags when processing chunks.
[*] Internal technical systems for creating enemies and animals have been improved. This affects new and future NPCs, as well as NPCs that will be upgraded in the future.
[/list]

[b]Bugfixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Cacti no longer caused damage when touched.
[*] When the bookmark was active, the recipe book was always reset to page 1 when opened.
[*] Slimes created with magic powder could be doubled again immediately.
[*] Magic dust could only be sprinkled on NPCs.
[/list]

[b]Known bugs[/b]
[list]
[*] Sometimes cliffs are not displayed correctly.
[/list]

[b]Coming soon[/b]
[list]
[*] New animations, e.g. a spear attack.
[*] First dungeons.
[/list]

notes.title: Running!
notes.notes:
This small update contains a few fixes, but also finally the ability to run! The implementation for this is not yet completely finished, as a performance update for map generation is still needed so that you can move faster without experiencing loading effects or stutters.


[b]New features[/b]
[list]
[*] You can now run with Shift [keyboard] or X [gamepad]. Your character will move 25% faster and consume stamina.
[*] Wealdheim houses are now locked at night.
[/list]

[b]Adjustments[/b]
[list]
[*] Tari moves slightly further away from the player character so that she is less likely to get in the way and accidentally start a conversation.
[/list]

[b]Technology[/b]
[list]
[*] Colliders for unfinished chunks have been optimized.
[*] The game now runs at 20 FPS when the window is inactive.
[/list]

[b]Bugfixes[/b]
[list]
[*] With an active bookmark, page turn sounds were played when dropping items.
[*] The migration of Marie, on the Wealdheim market, caused the NPC to be displayed twice for a short time.
[*] The Christmas tree in the title screen had no lights.
[/list]

[b]Known bugs[/b]
[list]
[*] Sometimes cliffs are not displayed correctly.
[/list]

[b]Coming soon[/b]
[list]
[*] A major performance update.
[*] New enemies.
[*] New animations, e.g. a spear attack.
[*] First dungeons.
[/list]

notes.title: Big Christmas-Update
notes.notes:
Dear Little Legends Community,

The year is coming to an end and I have a big pre-Christmas present for you! With this update, the first three bosses in the game world have finally been completed. This is also accompanied by a considerable progress in the story. As always, many other things are also included in this update. Hence, you can now buy Christmas trees from Sao or fill bottles with milk for baking.

Tari, the Spectaria, now also has one or two little surprises in store, so I hope you enjoy exploring this update. Of course, as always, some things in the world cannot be respawned. I therefore recommend starting a new savegame.

Thank you all very much for your support over the years! ❤️


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40004523/3a22d937d3f032f213b3b35d2a3f8e426174df21.png[/img]

[b]New Objects[/b]
[list]
[*] You can now make standing torches at the carpenter's table.
[*] You will now receive Volgoda's Dark Scales (chest) and the Scale Helmet when you defeat Volgoda.
[*] Small slimes now have a chance to drop as wearable headgear.
[*] You can now buy a Christmas tree from Sao. Regular fir trees will no longer be displayed as Christmas trees. Snow will fall over the Christmas tree during the Christmas season.
[*]You can now craft different variants of copper and iron chain armor.
[*]You can now melt sand into glass to make bottles.
[*] Milk buckets can now be filled into bottles.
[/list]

[b]New Enemies[/b]
[list]
[*] You will find the new boss, the “Insectoid Serpent Volgoda”, north of the Portal Ruins.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40004523/8cb2de582367aa417d1e1a0617c6b97615a812a4.png[/img]

[b]New Features[/b]
[list]
[*] If you talk to Tari (the Spectaria) in Runika, she can warp you back to your current respawn location.
[*] When crafting items directly from the recipe book, emptied items (e.g. buckets) are automatically returned to your inventory.
[*] You can now see what time it is at any time on the daytime wheel.
[*] You can now throw items into the trash can in the inventory again.
[/list]

[b] Graphics[/b]
[list]
[*] The save game book now has a “no saved games yet” graphic.
[*] The boss health bar and damage feedback have been visually improved.
[*] When you are slimed by Blargh, slime will drip from your character until the movement debuff disappears.
[*] The image for the milk bucket has been improved.
[*] Houses are now partially lit at night.
[*] The light display of street lamps has been improved.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40004523/4eaac9189523209de92dce04c42f11510f1c5825.png[/img]

[b]Story[/b]
[list]
[*] Many characters now react to the progress you make when defeating the Rift Guardians around the ruins.
[*] Tari (the Spectaria) now reacts to more events regarding the Rift Guardians and has dialogs adjusted accordingly.
[/list]

[b]Wealdheim[/b]
[list]
[*] You can now buy or sell animal products from Bertolf at the market.
[*] Enya, in the Adventurer's Guild, now offers all kinds of dishes and adventurer's tea for sale.
[*] Sao and Jabbar now also trade the items you receive as boss loot.
[/list]

[b]The Rift[/b]
[list]
[*] The story of how you meet Tari (the Spectaria) is slightly modified so that Tari now follows you right at the beginning of the game and can provide helpful hints.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40004523/441299239254918e4ea7e8320c5836caee16417f.png[/img]

[b] Adjustments[/b]
[list]
[*] Marie now also trades peaches.
[*] Green slimes now have 7 health points.
[*] New achievements.
[*] Boss loot boxes now have their own durability to withstand “explosions” (e.g. lightning strikes).
[*] Pigs now also drop leather.
[*] The raw materials required to craft the tunic, leather jerkin and leather armor have been slightly changed.
[*] The stats of the lime slime armor, leather jerkin, and leather armor have been slightly adjusted accordingly.
[*] Potatoes can no longer be baked in the loam smelter.
[*] Cheesecake now requires milk bottles instead of a milk bucket.
[*] The baking times in the oven have been adjusted.
[/list]

[b]Quality of Life[/b]
[list]
[*] You can now interact with objects and harvest plants even if you are holding a placeable item.
[*] You no longer start a dialog when trying to place objects near an NPC.
[*] The distinction between interactions with world objects and NPCs has been improved.
[*] You can now view the basic controls in the settings.
[/list]

[b]Technology[/b]
[list]
[*] Many internal technical optimizations regarding items and entities (world objects).
[*] Minor technical adjustments and optimizations in various systems.
[/list]

[b]Performance[/b]
[list]
[*] Slight performance improvement in the retrieval of object data.
[/list]

[b]Bugfixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Sometimes animals break out of their enclosures when loading chunks. This should now happen less often or no longer.
[*] In the farm house, carpets could sometimes be placed in the wall.
[*] After the game was “minimized”, it could happen that some timers ran too fast for a short time afterwards.
[*] When crafting a new item, the recipe book no longer jumps back to page 1 if a bookmark is active.
[*] No battle music was played when fighting multiple bosses in a row.
[*] The explosion resistance formula had a small mathematical error.
[*] Old barrels and crates no longer dropped loot.
[*] The Soulflame Path flames in the Rift were sometimes incorrectly depth-sorted.
[*] When obtaining a new item, the recipe book is now updated, even if it is closed.
[/list]

[b]Known Bugs[/b]
[list]
[*] Sometimes cliffs are not displayed correctly.
[/list]

[b]Coming Soon[/b]
[list]
[*] New enemies.
[*] New character animations, e.g. for running.
[*] First dungeons.
[/list]

notes.title: Storm-Crystal Boss
notes.notes:
A long year and a half have passed since Blargh found his way into Little Legends. With Aztetor, the second of the three Rift Guardians is finally entering the game. Of course, a lot has also happened in the background and, in addition to new items, there are also new Halloween and Christmas effects! I'm already working on the third Rift Guardian boss in the background. Unfortunately, you will have to start a new savegame to fight the new boss. Special places will not be re-spawned to prevent your builds from being destroyed.


[b]New mobs[/b]
[list]
[*] You will find the new boss “Storm Crystal Aztetor” east of the Portal Ruins.
[/list]

[b]New objects[/b]
[list]
[*] Aztetor drops the “Aztetor's Crystal Void” loot box to you.
[*] If you defeat Aztetor, you will find a Storm Crystal Spear in his loot box. It has a 28% chance of triggering a lightning strike.
[*] Blargh and Aztetor now leave energy cores in their loot boxes.
[/list]

[b]New features[/b]
[list]
[*] The following items will now spawn bats in the week leading up to Halloween: The Bone Chest, the Jack-'o-Lantern, and the Bone Armor while you're wearing it.
[*] The following items will trigger a small snow shower at Christmas time: The Gift Box, the Candy Cane Fence, and the Christmas Tree.
[/list]

[b]Graphic[/b]
[list]
[*] Lynea's graphics in the main menu and loading screen are now in high-res.
[*] There is now a new and more recognizable animation when Blargh's “slime bones” impact.
[/list]

[b]Portal Ruins[/b]
[list]
[*] The Portal Ruins and the Aether Gathering Points where Blargh and Aztetor appear have been visually upgraded.
[/list]

[b]Customizations[/b]
[list]
[*] The treasure chests at special places, such as abandoned gardens, are now more varied.
[*] The character's hit box is 1 “retro” pixel smaller in radius, giving you more room to maneuver when fighting mobs without getting hit by them.
[*] Blargh's loot table now includes energy cores.
[/list]

[b]Technology[/b]
[list]
[*] The internal damage-receiver and touch damage system have been reworked.
[*] Blargh's tech has been migrated to the systems optimized for Aztetor.
[*] Some internal technical improvements.
[/list]

[b]Bug fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] On slower PCs, your character could experience a “backsave” when saving and immediately reloading.
[*] Regions were saved twice when leaving the map.
[*] There was a worker task memory leak when changing levels.
[*] Some effects caused a memory leak.
[*] Ghosts could no longer interact with the environment and be attacked.
[*] Mycelium, which was replaced by the new mushrooms in the previous update, could cause loading errors with chunks.
[*] Crafting items would not add newly unlocked items to the recipe book until you interacted with the crafting table again.
[*] The item tool tip was not always hidden when closing the inventory.
[/list]

[b]Known bugs[/b]
[list]
[*] Sometimes cliffs are not displayed correctly.
[/list]

[b]Coming soon[/b]
[list]
[*] Another Rift Guardian boss and new enemies.
[/list]

notes.title: Feel-good Update
notes.notes:
The Wealdheim update has made it possible to leave the Runika map by entering buildings for the first time. Some objects were not yet designed for this and therefore always started growing from zero. This also happened if you moved too far away from your farm, for example. This update finally brings almost all remaining growth objects to the new system. As always, I have included many more things in this update package. Have fun exploring!


[b]New objects[/b]
[list]
[*] Rumor has it that Jabbar now has an oversized red witch hat on offer.
[*] You can now craft a stone stool at the crafting table.
[*] You can now create new storage crates at the various crafting tables, which also have different storage capacities.
[*] There are new mushrooms called Bloodcap. These are displayed with the previous mushroom image. Regular mushrooms now have a new image.
[*] Bloodcaps can be planted via the new mycelium called Bloodroot.
[*] Bloodcaps are not edible without first being grilled on a campfire.
[/list]

[b]New features[/b]
[list]
[*] Special raw material sources can now respawn regularly. This applies to large sources of coal, gold, iron, copper and stone. The raw material sources for copper and stone are new additions. All other sources can also respawn in existing maps.
[*] You can now sit on stools and benches. All you have to do is interact with the seat. You can use the direction arrows to change your viewing direction, change position on a bench or stand up again.
[*] All storage crates now have three new QoL features. You can use a button to transfer all resources from your inventory to the crate that are already stored there. You can also replenish the resources in your inventory from the crate and crates can now be sorted automatically.
[*] Baby animals now use the new growth system. This means that they no longer start growing again every time they are reloaded. When you return to your farm after some time, the growth will now be recalculated correctly.
[*] Fruits and beehives on trees now also use the new growth system and therefore no longer respawn when leaving buildings.
[/list]

[b] Graphics[/b]
[list]
[*] Small color improvements to some tools.
[*] The item tooltip no longer overlaps the last field of the quick-inventory.
[*] Your character now has two new animations (panic and confusion), which can appear in certain situations or conversations.
[*] Bees now have a new graphic.
[*] The durability of objects is now always clearly displayed in white.
[/list]

[b]Wealdheim[/b]
[list]
[*] There are now more villagers you can talk to in Wealdheim.
[*] The Wealdheim Theater is now better lit when you go to the hammer contest at night.
[*] The street lamps on the Wealdheim Market could be removed.
[*] Pigeons will now fly away when you approach them. However, they may return after a while.
[/list]

[b]The Rift[/b]
[list]
[*] The lost mushroom path has been improved with special mushrooms. These contract and block paths, or open up to reveal new paths.
[*] The rift fog has been graphically adapted to the retro style of the magic floors and recolored.
[*] Better player guidance to the path to Runika through new street lamps.
[*] You can now find Mycelium and a Bone Club in the Rift.
[/list]

[b]Customizations[/b]
[list]
[*] You can now pick up objects directly in front of your character when you click further away with the mouse.
[*] Different storage crates now have different storage capacities.
[*] You can now also use shelves and cupboards to store items.
[*] If you move away from a door without entering the house, the door will now be closed again.
[*] Some plants and seedlings had too short growth times, which is why these have now been extended.
[*] The growth penalty for non-irrigated plants has been reduced from 4x to 3x.
[*] Mushrooms can now be planted on farmland and receive the growth bonus of irrigated farmland accordingly. In addition, mushrooms now only grow at night unless they are planted around a tree.
[*] Recipes that use Mushrooms and Bloodcaps have been adjusted accordingly.
[*] Ravens now leave at least one feather.
[*] If you want to place an item when there is no room for it, another interaction action will no longer be performed instead (such as picking something up).
[*] Damaged beehives are restored at different rates at different times of day.
[*] The wooden spear no longer requires a rope to be crafted earlier.
[/list]

[b]Performance[/b]
[list]
[*] The performance for ground detection of actors has been improved and is now practically independent of how many actors are active at the same time.
[/list]

notes.title: Wealdheim
notes.notes:
After more than 5 months, I present to you the Wealdheim update! This is the first playable town in the world of Little Legends.

Over the past few months, I have created a lot of core technology to be able to add more locations, quests and dungeons to the game. Wealdheim also shows how important the community feedback is during the Early Access phase, because originally hardly any stroy content was planned and now more and more lore is being developed, which is gradually finds its way into the world.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40004523/c991a1307f8e75d037bd4649582bf43b0cca80b9.png[/img]

[b]Welcome to Wealdheim![/b]

Once upon a time, the “Ancients” traveled to other worlds by creating magical bridges through the Rift. Shortly before Azgorath corrupted the portals, separating the worlds again, the world of Runika was discovered - this is where we are playing in Little Legends so far. The descendants of the Ancients, the Ulan'mor, have been living on Runika ever since, together with some former settlers from other worlds, and inhabit the small town of Wealdheim.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40004523/49d720e23ede5c9d4e39ba20e6f8808d0870dd58.png[/img]

The Wealdheim Theater Square welcomes you with the first in-game event. The Adventurers' Guild is organizing the opening of the theater with a hammer competition in which you can win the key to your farmhouse! I'm planning more events on the theater square in the future to further enrich village life.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40004523/7be9366fb175d30d1c55e660c09dd216d9182fc1.png[/img]

[b]Your farm[/b]

A little run down, but well located. Your farm is right next to the Adventurers' Guild and the market is not far away either. Here you can settle in, repair the fences, plant fields and grow your crops. You will also find some sticks and flints to make your first tools.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40004523/da6f6ce8d2dad352ff13150c28e83df7e2128112.png[/img]

[b]The market[/b]

You can buy and sell all kinds of things on the market. The Ulan'mor trade in gold coins, but there are plans to add other currencies for other folks in the future! The merchants accept everything for sale that they themselves offer, so just browse through their books.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40004523/84963494195e72c4b63ac53ab9b87fd96f565a9b.png[/img]

Finally, you can buy things again that were previously only available in limited numbers. In addition to the new Christmas items, Sao offers various items as soon as you have found them for the first time. You can also buy the first headgear in the game at the market to turn your character into a Little Fashion Legend!


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40004523/22c08ae6ad59d290e2ca12cd6cca1f6d5ebc4121.png[/img]

With the new map and save system, Little Legends now supports three different types of levels:

[olist]
[*] The classic randomly generated main world with improved special locations.
[*] Levels, like the player house, whose interior you can customize.
[*] Completely static levels, such as the villagers' houses.
[/olist]

In addition to these major innovations and preparations for the future, there are a few other things to discover. Since the game world is generated and saved, I recommend starting a new game world, otherwise the new areas can not be generated.


[b]New objects[/b]
[list]
[*] You can now buy corn seed and tomato saplings at the market.
[*] Headgear can be purchased from a merchant.
[*] Peach trees now grow in the basalt plains.
[*] You can now craft a small outhouse.
[*] Recipes for wooden benches made from normal and birch wood can be found at the carpenter's table.
[*] You can now grill apples and mushrooms at the campfire.
[*] Christmas chests and candy cane fences are now new objects that you can buy from Sao and which retain their appearance permanently.
[/list]

[b] Graphics[/b]
[list]
[*] Trees now cast shadows.
[*] When you enter a special place, the location name is now displayed.
[*] The images for the Leather Armor and Leather Jerkin have been improved.
[/list]

[b]Customizations[/b]

[*] The Spectaria now explains the Home Totem.
[*] When you open the inventory in new savegames, you will see a guide to the next step in the game.
[*] Chickens now always drop feathers and grass always drops fiber.
[*] If you mine a pile of wood, you will now get the wood back directly.
[*] The "readability" of the magic bridge in the rift has been improved.
[*] Raw potatoes can no longer be eaten to avoid confusion with planting.
[*] The durability of some wooden and gold tools and weapons has been increased.
[*] Some item descriptions are now more descriptive of their functionality.
[*] The Spectaria no longer gives hints during battles.
[/list]

[b]Technology[/b]

[*] A new level core allows me to create many new levels more uniformly.
[*] To save the different levels, your savegame will be migrated automatically. The “regions” folder will become “map.x”.
[*] The technical anchor point of objects in the game world (entities) has been moved to the bottom left. Your savegames are automatically migrated accordingly.

notes.title: 2 Years Early Access
notes.notes:
Dear Little Legends Community,

It's crazy how time flies. For 2 years now we have been in Early Access and a lot has happened! Your feedback, especially in the livestreams, has contributed a lot to this. Even if there was criticism about a too early Early Access launch, I was able to derive important feedback from it. More content and, above all, an in-game story have been the focus of development ever since.

I would like to express my special thanks to all content creators. It is worth so much to be able to see exactly where there are difficulties in understanding. The new crafting Ui, for example, is a derivative of this.

Thank you also for your patience with the progress of the game. I'm still developing Little Legends on my own alongside my regular job, but thanks to your support I've already been able to reduce my weekly hours to work more on the game. :)


[b]What's next?[/b]

If you're not following the livestreams, here's a little preview of the next big topic. While I'm working on it, there are always small updates that result from the improvements and expansions.

The world "Runika" gets its first small settlement with NPCs and merchants with "Wealdheim". A wide-reaching lore is also being created around all of this, which is gradually finds its way into the game world.


You can sell your farm produce and buy seeds for new plants at the Wealdheim market.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40004523/0c9c78446f6d76307823e623e348eb24743b03ff.png[/img]


Other traders will have hats for your character and curiosities to decorate your farm.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40004523/695311eb46477c48d481a71fc7343322528b1c4e.png[/img]


You have probably already noticed the gold coin symbol next to your quick inventory. Here you can see how much gold you have in the future. I am currently planning to introduce different currencies on different worlds.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40004523/388a1a370555c366976256032ff25f17844222e4.png[/img]


In Wealdheim you get your own little farm to build up. However, you are of course still free to build anywhere in the world.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40004523/e4e47922ccac26703e12411c8c6029d4b2892595.png[/img]


I am currently working on a system for you to decorate your farmhouse with furniture!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40004523/ef1305eca3b218a1f39c0da0ed9ec9c0168509fc.png[/img]


Over time, Wealdheim will certainly be expanded even further than I am planning for the first update. The adventurers' guild will play an important role in this and I am currently planning for you to help build up the cozy village.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40004523/bef8cda436022179857e528a042c5fe1d747949b.png[/img]


As you can see, A World of Little Legends is currently evolving from a storyless "Minecraft in 2D" to a world that takes you on a journey to one day save the people of the worlds from the threat of "Azgorath" from the Rift.

I wish you lots of fun in A World of Little Legends and look forward to exciting new topics in the Early Access phase! :)

notes.title: Early Access Release
notes.notes:
The new year begins and with it the Early Access release date for A World of Little Legends is finally set!

It was important to me from the beginning to only start in the Early Access, when all features which I consider important for it are included. In the last weeks and months we were able to make a lot of progress in the gamedev streams and therefore we could move into the testing and polishing phase earlier than expected.

Since it's important not to release during a Steam Fest, we're avoiding the fest at the end of February and launching directly the day after, March 1st!

Almost two years after starting the project, I'm very excited and also a little bit nervous about my first big game release, even though I've already developed and published several games over the years. However, A World of Little Legends is a very special project for me and therefore a big thank you goes to all the viewers of the stream who directly or indirectly support me in making this dream come true. Thank you!
